description: This is a Python test script for end-to-end testing of team blocking behavior across multiple instances in a distributed setup. The script defines helper functions to interact with team and chat APIs, and contains an async test function that performs a sequence of operations: creating a team, verifying its status, updating its blocked state, and verifying the effects on chat responses across different server ports.

methods.name: generate_team_key( session, team_id: str, max_budget: Optional[float] = None, )
methods.description: Helper function to generate a key for a specific team by sending a POST request to the key generation endpoint.

methods.name: update_team_block_status(session, team_id: str, blocked: bool, port: int)
methods.description: Helper function to update a team's 'blocked' status via the update endpoint.

methods.name: get_team_info(session, team_id: str, port: int)
methods.description: Helper to retrieve team information from a specific instance port.

methods.name: chat_completion_on_port( session, key: str, model: str, port: int, prompt: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Helper function to make a chat completion request on a specified server port with an optional prompt.

methods.name: test_team_blocking_behavior_multi_instance()
methods.description: Main asynchronous test function that verifies team blocking behavior across multiple server instances, including creation, status verification, blocking updates, and response validation.
